gloss: fine article; excellent product; quality piece

definitions.gloss: fine article; excellent product; quality piece
definitions.explanation: An item of notably good quality, whether a piece of art, a literary work, or a well-crafted product.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{陶器|とうき}→陶器：14531_touki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{佳品|かひん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: This ceramic piece is known as a fine article.

examples.japanese: ⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{佳品|かひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいた→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Many fine works were displayed at the exhibition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手|て}がけた→手がける：12753_tegakeru⟧{佳品|かひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数々|かずかず}→数々：12722_kazukazu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{贈答用|ぞうとうよう}→贈答用：20285_zoutouyou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}ばれている→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: The many fine articles crafted by local artisans are also well received as gifts.

notes:
A compound of {佳|か} (good, beautiful, fine) and ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (article, item). A literary and somewhat formal word. While {佳|か} can describe beauty in a general sense, {佳品|かひん} specifically emphasizes quality craftsmanship or artistic merit rather than just aesthetic appeal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {佳品|かひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to collect fine articles
- {佳品|かひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: fine pieces are lined up
- ⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ぞ⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧{佳品|かひん}: a fine article known to connoisseurs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{名品|めいひん}→名品：19478_meihin⟧: masterpiece; famous article — implies wider recognition and higher prestige
- ⟦{逸品|いっぴん}→逸品：19463_ippin⟧: gem; outstanding item — stronger praise, suggesting something exceptional
- {良品|りょうひん}: quality goods — more commercial, emphasizing reliable quality over artistic merit
